categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research and development, factory-based cultivation, and sales of fresh edible mushrooms. Main product lines include enoki mushrooms (golden needle mushrooms), true oyster mushrooms (including crab-flavored mushrooms, white jade mushrooms, and seafood mushrooms), king oyster mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, and deer antler mushrooms. The company operates through multiple subsidiaries across different regions in China and internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs factory-based (controlled environment) cultivation technology for edible mushroom production, utilizing industrial-scale techniques with automated equipment and standardized processes. This method involves precise control of temperature, humidity, ventilation, and lighting to create optimal growing conditions. The company has developed proprietary strain improvement and breeding technologies, including hybridization breeding research and strain purification methods. The company holds multiple patents and plant variety rights for its mushroom strains.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse customer segments including distributors/wholesalers, supermarket chains, connected restaurant systems (hot pot and spicy hot pot restaurants), and fresh-to-home e-commerce platforms. Primary end markets are domestic Chinese consumers seeking fresh, high-quality edible mushrooms for culinary use. The company also exports to international markets including Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, and other countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates eight major production bases in mainland China: Changchun (Jilin), Dezhou (Shandong), Huizhou (Guangdong), Dujiangyan (Sichuan), Bijie (Guizhou), Lingtao (Gansu), Guigang (Guangxi), and Huai'an (Jiangsu). Internationally, the company has established a production base in Thailand. This nationwide layout enables the company to serve regional markets efficiently and maintain product freshness.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It sources raw materials (agricultural byproducts such as rice bran, corn cobs, wheat bran, cottonseed hulls, brewery waste, and soybean hulls) from suppliers, processes them through factory-based cultivation, and distributes finished fresh mushroom products directly to wholesalers, retailers, and food service operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) strengthening and refining core products (enoki and seafood mushrooms) with stable production and quality; (2) continuous cost reduction and efficiency improvement through process optimization and formula refinement; (3) strain improvement through hybridization breeding and purification; (4) technology innovation to enhance product quality stability; (5) talent acquisition and management system improvements; (6) brand building and marketing to increase brand premium. The company is designated as a key laboratory by the Ministry of Agriculture for edible mushroom strain research.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of fresh edible mushrooms via a buy-and-sell distribution model. Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers, which occurs at delivery to distributors or upon customer confirmation of receipt for direct sales. The company employs dynamic daily pricing based on market conditions, with prices set by regional sales managers and approved by senior management. Secondary revenue comes from sales of cultivation substrate (培养基), materials, and equipment rental.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the largest factory-based edible mushroom producer in China by production capacity, with 1,680 tons daily capacity (including 1,275 tons of enoki mushrooms). It ranks first nationally in enoki mushroom production. The company competes with other factory-based producers in an increasingly competitive market characterized by overcapacity, particularly in enoki mushrooms. As of November 2024, there were 311 factory-based edible mushroom producers in China, with 22 having ceased operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of 2,162.45 million yuan, representing a 15.70% decline from 2023's 2,565.14 million yuan. The company reported a net loss of 617.07 million yuan attributable to shareholders in 2024, compared to a loss of 188.06 million yuan in 2023. Total assets decreased to 3,854.56 million yuan from 4,602.17 million yuan. The company's financial performance has deteriorated due to industry overcapacity, price declines, and strategic capacity contraction.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes food safety through controlled factory-based production that eliminates pesticides and environmental contamination risks. Key differentiators include: (1) superior product quality and consistency through standardized processes; (2) nationwide distribution network enabling fresher products closer to consumers; (3) brand recognition as a national agricultural industrialization leader; (4) proprietary strain varieties with superior characteristics; (5) technological leadership in factory-based cultivation; (6) comprehensive quality management systems. The company positions itself as a trusted provider of safe, high-quality edible mushrooms.
